title: Headers missing: Bitcoin attestation present, no headers -> UNVERIFIABLE
registered_case: BAND0-EXIT E10 'headers missing -> UNVERIFIABLE'; A2.2 waiver-status paragraph
scenario: The temporal check cannot be performed because the headers h*..h*+5 are unavailable. Not a failure: unperformable.

mutations.heights: h*..h*+5 (900024..900029) of the receipt proof; the six entries of the bundle's headers member, and nothing else

test_universe.post_edit: delete exactly the header entries h*..h*+5 from layers[0].headers of the already-issued honest bundle; trust.json (pins for 900025..900029 included), release.json and every other member stay byte-identical; re-serialize the container canonically

choices: No temporal model carries an unperformable arm: the bridge excludes it (P5cP5P6_Bridge.tla:73-75) and P5P6 has none. The vector rests on P4's partition plus A2.2's text, not on a temporal trace.

needs: A real receipt; delete only the six receipt-proof headers h*..h*+5 from the bundle, keeping the pinned trust configuration and release unchanged (if the heights are shared with snapshot/git heights, delete only heights not used by them, or expect the snapshot/git rows to change).

subcases.construction: A-a (honest TEST issue) bytes with ONLY the six headers h*..h*+5 removed from layers[0].headers; trust configuration, release and every other member byte-identical to the honest fixture
subcases.T_derivation: T null: no qualifying attestation (row 11.4); U null

subcases.construction: Control: the same bundle with the six headers restored (A-a unchanged); trust, release and all members as the honest fixture
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5)
subcases.title: Headers restored control: VALID_STRICT / OK
